scripts.start: pnpm run prepare:runtime && pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others --names server,client "pnpm run server:ready" "pnpm run client:ready"
scripts.start:vanilla: pnpm run prepare:runtime && pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others --names world-1,client "pnpm --filter @august/server start:world -- --world=1" "pnpm run client:ready"
scripts.server: pnpm run prepare:runtime && pnpm run server:ready
scripts.server:ready: pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others --names world-1,world-2 "pnpm --filter @august/server start:world -- --world=1" "pnpm --filter @august/server start:world -- --world=2"
scripts.check: pnpm check:repository && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.check:repository: pnpm check:structure && pnpm check:naming && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm check:generated && pnpm check:documentation && pnpm test:repository
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:packages && pnpm typecheck:tools && pnpm --filter @august/server typecheck:all && pnpm --filter @august/client typecheck:all
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @august/tools test && pnpm --filter @august/server test && pnpm --filter @august/client test
scripts.test:all: pnpm --filter @august/tools test && pnpm --filter @august/server test:all && pnpm --filter @august/client test:all
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @august/server build && pnpm --filter @august/client build && pnpm check:client-artifacts && pnpm docs:build
